ranked.headline: Generative and transformer models couple spatial context with regulatory structure
ranked.summary: Spatial and single-cell foundation models now predict perturbation responses, expression and imputation from sparse multimodal measurements.

ranked.headline: Models link noncoding variants to chromatin, methylation and expression effects
ranked.summary: Deep learning, mQTL and trans-eQTL frameworks now score variant effects on chromatin state, methylation and expression within one analytic frame.

ranked.headline: Coarse and DEL-trained models predict protein-ligand binding without full-atom detail
ranked.summary: Learned protein-ligand models now use coarse pocket representations, distance distributions, and DEL screening data as training sources.

ranked.headline: Deep learning links spatial, single-cell and multi-omics data to tissue niches
ranked.summary: Deep learning models are being applied to spatial, single-cell and longitudinal multi-omics to resolve tissue domains and niches.

ranked.headline: Harmonized single-cell atlases paired with ML to rank disease targets and senescence
ranked.summary: Large harmonized single-cell atlases are being paired with ML models for senescence detection, lineage inference, and target ranking.

ranked.headline: Protein language models and knowledge guidance predict molecular binding
ranked.summary: Protein language model embeddings are now dissected mechanistically and fused with multiscale or cross-modal architectures for binding prediction.

ranked.headline: Computational inference from tandem mass spectra and in silico metabolism prediction
ranked.summary: Public spectral archives of 1.32 billion MS/MS spectra and new benchmarks now make spectrum-based metabolite and peptide inference testable at scale.

ranked.headline: Algorithms correcting sequencing errors and haplotypes in viral genome data
ranked.summary: Recent tools model sequencing error sources explicitly, from read-level haplotype phasing to pandemic-scale SARS-CoV-2 phylogenetics.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models refine peptide and metabolite identification in mass spectrometry
ranked.summary: Zero-shot and deep learning methods now address per-run training and missingness limits in DIA and label-free mass spectrometry analysis.

ranked.headline: Sparse and indirect genomic measurements are used to infer hidden tumor states
ranked.summary: Standard-depth cfDNA and single-cell genomes now support inference of tumor transcriptomes, amplicon evolution and homolog-specific copy number.

ranked.headline: Pretrained biological sequence models repurposed via reshaped input representations
ranked.summary: Reduced alphabets, learned chunking and distillation are making pretrained sequence models faster and more transferable across genomes and proteins.

ranked.headline: Sequence-based inference of admixture, ancestral graphs, and human genome diversity
ranked.summary: Early-2026 releases pair a stable ancestral recombination graph library with learned ARG embeddings and admixture studies in dogs and Khoe-San populations.

ranked.headline: LLM agents couple reasoning to bioinformatics tools for verifiable single-cell analysis
ranked.summary: Verifiable benchmarks and grounded agents now test whether LLMs can carry out multi-step scRNA-seq analysis reliably.

ranked.headline: Learned models and long-read workflows dissect RNA splicing and isoform diversity
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair deep sequence models with long-read and single-cell transcriptomics to resolve splicing and isoform structure.

ranked.headline: Controlling false positives in differential expression across transcriptomic designs
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers address power, batch effects, meta-analysis, and Type I error control in RNA-seq, spatial, and multi-omics DE testing.

ranked.headline: Benchmarked pipelines for microbial amplicon, metagenomic, and genomic data
ranked.summary: Amplicon error inflation and expanding multi-omic datasets make quantitative pipeline validation essential for microbial studies.

ranked.headline: Machine learning infers age, biomarkers and time from molecular profiles
ranked.summary: Routine methylation arrays and blood metabolomics are now being repurposed as inputs for quantitative estimates of age, biomarkers and time since death.

ranked.headline: Explicit mechanistic models of metabolic, regulatory, and cell-state transitions
ranked.summary: Explicit model structure is increasingly used to explain threshold behavior, irreversible cell-state transitions, and signaling dynamics.

ranked.headline: Comparative genomes link lineage-specific gene evolution to ecology and traits
ranked.summary: Chromosome-scale assemblies now enable synteny-aware and methylation-informed tests of gene gain, loss, and acceleration across taxa.

ranked.headline: Physics-informed diffusion and free-energy biasing steer biomolecular generation
ranked.summary: Pretrained biomolecular diffusion models are now being steered at inference by energy terms and free-energy estimators for ensembles and hit triage.

ranked.headline: Harmonized metadata layers for public omics samples, datasets, and sequencing outputs
ranked.summary: Five recent preprints pair metadata harmonization with portable packaging and local or cloud deployment for omics data reuse.

ranked.headline: Modular and packaged frameworks for epidemic, neural, and molecular simulation
ranked.summary: Reusable simulation and analysis tools now emphasize explicit interfaces, cross-simulator validation, and standard distribution for biological modeling…

ranked.headline: LLM-based agents and reasoning steer molecule optimization and drug benchmarking
ranked.summary: Composed LLM agent systems are now evaluated alongside base models across recent drug discovery preprints and a published modular agent.

ranked.headline: ML tools link bacterial genotypes to resistance and gene essentiality
ranked.summary: Large bacterial sequence and spectra datasets now support interpretable models for resistance prediction, species identification and Tn-Seq benchmarking.

ranked.headline: Faster phylogenetic placement and optimal sequence-to-graph alignment at genome scale
ranked.summary: Expanding pangenome and biobank-scale datasets demand phylogenetic and alignment methods with favorable runtime scaling.

ranked.headline: MD and QM/MM simulations resolve free-energy landscapes of transient biomolecular states
ranked.summary: Atomistic and coarse-grained simulations now attribute transport, binding, and catalysis to short-lived states on free-energy landscapes.

ranked.headline: Simulations resolve transient states that select binding, gating and fusion pathways
ranked.summary: Enhanced-sampling MD and CABS-dock simulations now resolve pathway-determining intermediates in receptor, channel and membrane systems.

ranked.headline: Computational tools rank and interpret candidate genes across disease and metabolism
ranked.summary: Network, dependency, and LLM-based literature tools now prioritize genes and interpret enrichment, though none reports experimental validation.

ranked.headline: Controlled evolutionary simulations and diversity metrics test what sequence data reveal
ranked.summary: Generative and simulated evolution benchmarks now probe whether protein sequence data support accurate inference of structure and selection.

ranked.headline: Noise-robust fMRI connectivity and open epilepsy connectomes for biomarker discovery
ranked.summary: Short-scan fMRI robustness and open, clinically annotated connectome releases are now available for biomarker development.

ranked.headline: Reorganization costs and iterative docking address kinase and transporter selectivity
ranked.summary: Explicit receptor and ligand conformational modeling now informs selectivity and potency predictions across kinase, transporter, and TDP-43 studies.

ranked.headline: Learned descriptors and benchmarks for cryo-EM particle curation and RNA motif modeling
ranked.summary: Geometry-aware particle filtering and an open cryo-EM RNA benchmark address particle selection and machine learning evaluation for structure modeling.

ranked.headline: Computational tools extract dynamic and spatial structure from Hi-C, MD and cryo-ET data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication extend deep learning and point-cloud methods to 4D chromatin, residue dynamics and particle curation in tomography.

ranked.headline: Model-based tools infer population size, microbiome disease risk, and motif structure
ranked.summary: Each item pairs flexible statistical or neural models with preprocessing tailored to sparse, compositional, or redundant genomic data structures.

ranked.headline: Stochastic switching and resource competition shape population-scale outcomes
ranked.summary: Three February 2026 preprints explicitly link stochastic dynamics, strategy switching, and resource competition to population-scale behavior.

ranked.headline: Computational methods map spatial co-localization, causal regulation and enhancer hubs
ranked.summary: Correlation and linear measures miss per-cell co-localization, uncorrelated causal regulators and multi-way enhancer hubs.

ranked.headline: Web and Python platforms make omics and biochemical data interactively queryable
ranked.summary: Large omics matrices and fragmented biochemical databases motivate interactive access layers that lower the barrier to analysis.
